Search NCBI GEO for expression series (GSE) as GeneFox's GEO search does (smart synonym expansion,...

gf_geo_search.Rd

Search NCBI GEO for expression series (GSE) as GeneFox's GEO search does (smart synonym expansion, filters), returning accession, sample count and a usability prediction for each. Start with query; continue with cursor and optional limit only. next_cursor retains unreturned rows and the exact searched term in this process. Latency: 2-10 s. Matches the GeneFox app's GEO › Search results (without its per-device usability notes).

Usage

gf_geo_search(
    session,
    `cursor` = NULL,
    `data_type` = NULL,
    `limit` = NULL,
    `min_samples` = NULL,
    `organism` = NULL,
    `query` = NULL,
    `smart_search` = NULL,
    `sort` = NULL,
    progress_callback = NULL
)

Arguments

session

A GeneFox session from gf_session.

cursor

(string, optional) Continue with data.next_cursor and optional limit only. Process-local cursors expire after 15 minutes idle; successful pages replay at the same limit. Unknown or expired cursors require a new search. NULL omits it.

data_type

(string, optional; one of "any", "expression_array", "expression_sequencing", "methylation_array", "methylation_sequencing", "noncoding_rna_sequencing", "genome_binding_sequencing"; default "any") GEO DataSet Type filter. NULL omits it.

limit

(integer, optional; default 10; range 1..20) How many results to return (1-20). NULL omits it.

min_samples

(string, optional; one of "any", "10", "50", "100", "500"; default "any") Minimum samples per series. NULL omits it.

organism

(string, optional; one of "human", "mouse", "rat", "fly", "zebrafish", "worm", "yeast", "any"; default "human") Organism filter. NULL omits it.

query

(string, optional) Free text or GEO accession: Unicode letters and digits, spaces and , . ; : ' / + _ - only. NULL omits it.

smart_search

(boolean, optional; default true) Expand the query with reviewed synonyms (the screen's default). NULL omits it.

sort

(string, optional; one of "relevance", "newest", "oldest", "most_samples", "fewest_samples"; default "relevance") Result order. NULL omits it.

progress_callback

Optional function receiving runtime progress events; NULL disables progress.

Value

A gf_result holding the engine payload, provenance and owned figures for the geo_search tool. The runtime validates every argument and refuses tools absent from its gf_tools() list. Result contract: https://genefox.app/schemas/v1/geo-search-result-v1.schema.json.

See also

gf_scientific_tools, gf_tools, gf_call
